◆ update_vap_stations_stats()

bool bwl::whm::mon_wlan_hal_whm::update_vap_stations_stats ( const std::string &  vap_iface_name,
const std::vector< sMacAddr > &  sta_macs,
std::unordered_map< sMacAddr, SStaStats > &  sta_stats,
bool  is_read_unicast 
)
overridevirtual

Update station statistics for multiple stations on one VAP.

The default implementation preserves the existing per-STA polling path. HALs may override it to update the requested VAP stations in bulk.

Parameters
[in]vap_iface_nameVAP interface name.
[in]sta_macsStation MAC addresses to update.
[in,out]sta_statsStation statistics keyed by sta_macs entries.
[in]is_read_unicastUse unicast TX packet counter when true.
Returns
true if no stations were requested or at least one station was updated.
